bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

items.stem: A hospital must ensure patient records are not altered by unauthorised staff. Which security property is the primary concern?

options.rationale: Correct: integrity protects data from unauthorised or accidental modification.
Availability concerns timely access, not whether data is altered.
Confidentiality concerns who can read data, not whether it is changed.
Non-repudiation proves who performed an action; it does not itself prevent alteration.

items.explanation: Preventing unauthorised modification is the definition of integrity.

items.stem: During which incident response phase is the threat isolated to stop further damage?

options.rationale: Correct: containment limits the spread and impact of an incident.
Detection identifies that an incident is occurring, before containment.
Recovery restores systems after the threat is removed.
Lessons learned is the post-incident review, after recovery.

items.explanation: Containment stops the incident spreading before eradication and recovery.

items.stem: Which TWO practices directly enforce the principle of least privilege?

options.text: Granting users only the permissions their role requires
options.rationale: Correct: role-scoped permissions are least privilege in action.

options.text: Removing access promptly when a role changes
options.rationale: Correct: timely deprovisioning keeps privileges minimal over time.

options.text: Giving all staff local administrator rights for convenience
options.rationale: This grants excess privilege, the opposite of least privilege.

options.text: Sharing one admin account across the team
options.rationale: Shared high-privilege accounts break accountability and over-grant access.

options.text: Disabling all logging to reduce noise
options.rationale: Logging is unrelated to privilege scope and should not be disabled.

items.explanation: Least privilege means minimal necessary access, enforced at grant time and on role change.
